summary: This 6-K filing reports that conditions precedent for a judicial purchase and sale agreement of Braskem shares have been fulfilled, and the transaction has closed. Under the agreement, Novonor and NSP Inv. sold shares to Shine I FIP, with consideration in the form of debentures. No price per share or premium was disclosed. The board did not issue a recommendation, and no named advisors were identified. The filing is the Brazilian equivalent of a material definitive agreement closing notice under US 8-K. Watch for potential regulatory challenges given the judicial reorganization context and ongoing involvement of Petrobras.
